topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I can't help but wonder what logic was applied to this decision. I was doing perfectly fine in my department, maybe even excelling. Suddenly, I'm being moved to a whole new team where I have to learn new systems, new faces, and adapt to a different work culture. It's not like I haven't shown my capabilities; I've put in the time, the effort. Now, I'm expected to start from square one again. It's a waste of my skills, and it feels like a step back. I really hope this move is as beneficial as they claim, because right now, it just feels like a disruption.
